en: A black‑and‑white photograph showing a tree-lined avenue in late autumn or early spring, with tall bare trees forming a corridor. A procession of people in early 20th‑century clothing walks along the path; some appear to be carrying banners or flags. Many onlookers stand on either side of the road. Handwritten text in a decorative script is visible at the bottom, and a date is written on the right side.
